text: OT: posting this in the hope that someone in the Trump administration sees it! I believe a democrat controlled “self regulatory” agency FINRA, has damaged small American businesses and is preventing equity investors from participating in small growth companies highest growth years. In 1996 there were over 9,000 publicly traded companies, in 2026 there are just 4,000. FINRA regulated small broker dealers - investment banking firms out of business at the behest of the big banks post Gramm, Leach, Bliley aka “Financial Services Modernization Act of 1999”. Now we have very large companies going public to achieve liquidity for the private backers, usually with the IPO buyers paying top dollar. In 2026 we now have less real opportunity for small growing companies who hire people!, to get EQUITY financed. Instead we get credit this, debt that B S!!! The solution? Repeal GLB and-or ban FINRA from interfering with small broker-dealer - investment banks that finance earlier stage, small companies. In my opinion FINRA acts as a mob boss for large firms, that is why there are 0 small broker dealers in business anymore, those firms provided equity financing to small growing companies - the life blood of economic growth.
